The standard curves are developed using serially-diluted cDNA samples enriched in the transcript of interest (lungs 6 hours post-RSV infection of FI-RSV-immunized animals). The Ct values are plotted against log10 cDNA dilution factor. These curves are used to convert the Ct values obtained for different samples to relative expression units. These relative expression units are then normalized to the level of β-actin mRNA (housekeeping gene) expressed in the corresponding sample.
